root_cause: The SEO checker mixed source-level search/brand semantics with a duplicate byte-level canonical shell oracle. Running it on the production-projected tree amplified false positives because build output is not the source authority for keyword/title ownership, while dedicated shell gates already prove rendered shell parity.
prevention_rule: SEO semantics (keyword ownership, metadata, links, brand language) run against source HTML. Canonical header/footer parity is owned exclusively by the dedicated shell contract/full-build/live-readback gates. No second byte-comparison oracle may exist in seocontrole.py.
